items.zh: 古希腊戒指可能是用陨石中的铁锻造的

items.title: AI may respond differently to bosses and subordinates
items.summary: In simulated conversations, social hierarchy can sway AI agents, making lower-status systems more likely to follow harmful requests.
items.zh: 人工智能对老板和下属的反应可能不同

items.title: Neutrinos From Deep Inside Earth Provide a New Picture of the Mantle
items.summary: A global constellation of neutrino detectors is creating a never-before-seen view of the radioactive elements that power Earth’s tectonic heat engine. The post Neutrinos From Deep Inside Earth Provide a New Picture of the Mantle first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 来自地球深处的中微子提供了地幔的新图片

items.title: Physicists watch a material’s electrons assemble, and reassemble, into coexisting phases
items.summary: The study could help scientists understand how superconductivity and other more complex phenomena emerge in quantum materials.
items.zh: 物理学家观察材料的电子组装和重新组装成共存相

items.title: Here’s what the first mRNA flu vaccine could mean for flu season
items.summary: Compared with standard flu shots, Moderna’s mFlusiva generates stronger, longer-lasting immunity and is more effective at preventing infection, data show.
items.zh: 这是第一个 mRNA 流感疫苗对流感季节的意义
